headline: Subshell 1.0: moderation tools, clearer comment threads and private data stored encrypted
highlights: Moderators can approve, remove or mark as spam from any ⋮ menu, change a post's flair, and see Removed, Edited and Unmoderated lists in Mod tools.
Comment threads are easier to follow: replies step right with each level (Settings > Comments > Reply indent), and Reply scrolls the comment you answer above the composer.
Tapping a post's flair searches its community for that flair, newest first.
New setting, off by default: Languages. Search skips communities and posts your phone is sure are in a language you have not chosen.
What is about you (inbox, joined communities, saved lists, hidden communities, notes, drafts, searches) is now stored encrypted. Diagnostics shows if anything cannot be opened.
Public posts, images and app settings are not encrypted. If something does not work for you, tell us on r/subshell or GitHub.
